claimed_purpose.text: The benchmark targets long-term dialogue consistency and engagingness in open-domain human-bot conversations.

mechanisms.text: Bot utterances in the conversation are annotated with the persona statement they ground to, indicated by an inline tab-separated label (e.g., U1, U2, B2).

ledger.claim: DuLeMon evaluates long-term dialogue consistency and dialogue engagingness as primary dimensions.
ledger.quote: Results on DuLeMon indicate that PLATO-LTM can significantly outperform baselines in terms of long-term dialogue consistency, leading to better dialogue engagingness.
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: DuLeMon is the dataset name, standing for Baidu Long-term Memory Conversation.
ledger.quote: Bai du L ong-t e rm M emory C on versation
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: The dataset is downloadable via a shell script at ./data/download_dulemon.sh.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: The primary evaluation metrics include long-term dialogue consistency and dialogue engagingness.
ledger.quote: PLATO-LTM can significantly outperform baselines in terms of long-term dialogue consistency, leading to better dialogue engagingness
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: The dataset is associated with Findings of ACL 2022.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: The conversation format includes persona-grounded utterance annotations linking bot/user turns to specific persona statement IDs.
ledger.quote: "Bot: 嗯嗯 ， 看起来 是 挺 轻松 的 。 你 还在 图书馆 里 打工 呢 。\tU1"
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: The PLATO-LTM framework code was listed as coming soon at time of publication.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: The dataset distinguishes between persona facts the user has already revealed in-session (user_said_persona) and facts not yet disclosed (user_no_said_persona), supporting evaluation of proactive persona elicitation.
ledger.quote: "user_said_persona": [...], "user_no_said_persona": ["U6: 我 在 上 大学"]
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: The dataset is named after its origin: Baidu Long-term Memory Conversation.
ledger.quote: Bai du L ong-t e rm M emory C on versation
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: The evaluation framework PLATO-LTM was listed as 'coming soon' at time of page capture; scoring code is not yet available in the repository.
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Long-term dialogue consistency is a primary evaluation dimension used on DuLeMon.
ledger.quote: Results on DuLeMon indicate that PLATO-LTM can significantly outperform baselines in terms of long-term dialogue consistency
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: The paper was accepted at Findings of ACL 2022.
ledger.quote: Accepted by Findings of ACL 2022 (Camera-ready version)
ledger.label: inferred
